Name: Australian Beer and Consumables Pack
Author: SkribTheModder
Description:
In a delightful twist of fate, Stardew Valley has recently received a shipment of new, exotic stock from the Land Down Under, Australia! The Stardrop Saloon and Pierre's General Store have teamed up to bring a taste of the Australian outback to the heart of the valley. Now, alongside the local favorites, residents and visitors can enjoy a unique selection of authentic Australian beverages, thanks to this exciting collaboration. From the iconic Bundaberg Rum known for its bold flavors to other refreshing Australian drinks, the valley's pub scene has never been this diverse. So, step into the Stardrop Saloon or pay a visit to Pierre's, and treat yourself to the Aussie spirit right here in Stardew Valley.

[b]Added items and locations:[/b]
[u]Purchasable from Saloon:[/u]
XXXX Gold 6 Pack --> Crafts 6x XXXX Gold (600g)
Victoria Bitter 6 Pack --> Crafts 6x Victoria Bitter (600g)
Carlton Dry 6 Pack --> Crafts 6x Carlton Dry (600g)
Great Northern 6 Pack --> Crafts 6x Great Northern (600g)
Bundaberg Rum Bottle --> Crafts 12x Bundaberg Rum (800g)
Goon Bag --> Crafts 20x Goon (400g)

[u]Purchasble from Pierre's General Store:[/u]
Winfield Blue 20 Pack --> Crafts 20x Winfield Blue Cigarettes (400g)

[i]Please note: All purchased items are a type of seed, they are used to craft the consumble versions of the item, check the player crafting menu accordingly
Caution: Avoid carrying the seeds near plantable land as this may cause stability issues in some cases
[/i]
[b]Stats vary for each item and can be seen below:[/b]
XXXX Gold: [25 Energy, 11 Health] [-1 Speed, +2 Luck, +2 Mining] Duration 180 Seconds
Victoria Bitter: [25 Energy, 11 Health] [-1 Speed, +2 Luck, +2 Farming] Duration 180 Seconds
Carlton Dry:  [25 Energy, 11 Health] [-1 Speed, +2 Luck, +2 Foraging] Duration 180 Seconds
Great Northern: [25 Energy, 11 Health] [-1 Speed, +2 Luck, +2 Fishing] Duration 180 Seconds
Goon: [25 Energy, 11 Health] [-1 Speed, +2 Luck] Duration 180 Seconds

Bundaberg Rum:  [25 Energy, 11 Health] [-1Speed, +2 Attack, +2 Defence] Duration 180 Seconds (fighting stat increase)
Winfield Blue Cigarette[1 Health, 3 Energy] [-1 Speed, +2 Luck] Duration 60 Seconds

[b]Please ensure you have installed the latest version of the dependencies, otherwise, the mod will not function correctly.[/b]

Downloads.Description:
Added various stat changes to each item.
A zip containing the files required for the mod. These are to be unzipped and placed in your StardewValley/Mods folder
